name: When should I call a professional for a gas line leak?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a gas line leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should always call a professional immediately if you suspect a gas line leak. Do not attempt to locate or fix the leak yourself. Natural gas and propane are highly flammable and dangerous. If you smell gas, hear a hissing sound, or notice other signs, prioritize your safety: evacuate everyone from the property, do not use light switches or electronics, and call Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC or your gas utility from a safe location. Our trained technicians are equipped to handle gas leaks safely and effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Always call a professional immediately for any suspected gas line leak due to safety risks. Evacuate, avoid electronics, and call from a safe location.
